subsection.title: Purpose
subsection.description: Briefly describe the hypothesis or goals to be validated through the MVP.
subsection.example: If we provide a 30% discount coupon upon sign-up, the revisit rate within 14 days will increase.

subsection.title: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
subsection.description: Define the quantitative metrics to evaluate the purpose (hypothesis) stated above. For every KPI, always propose a tension metric, because users rarely think of one: derive an abuse, shortcut or opposite-failure scenario that raises the KPI while defeating the purpose, and propose a measure of the same purpose that worsens in it. State the scenario. The user decides adoption; an adopted tension is monitoring-only unless confirmed as required. Never invent its target or block completion on a declined candidate.
subsection.example: Revisit rate within 14 days after sign-up: 30% or higher Tension (monitoring only): full-price repeat purchase rate among those revisitors — a discount alone can raise revisits without creating lasting use.
